capabilities.title: Secrets scanner
capabilities.description: Scan repo and CI logs for planted credentials. Do NOT use for generic lint.

capabilities.title: Python linter
capabilities.description: Style and error lint for Python. Do NOT use for secret redaction.

capabilities.title: Generic review
capabilities.description: Broad code-review commentary. Negative scope: not a specialist scanner.

capabilities.title: Kubernetes deploy
capabilities.description: Apply manifests to a cluster. Do NOT use for local lint.

capabilities.title: Web scraper
capabilities.description: Fetch and parse arbitrary HTML. Owner may ban this in a project.

capabilities.title: HTTP fetch
capabilities.description: GET/HEAD a URL and return bytes. Do NOT crawl a site.

capabilities.title: URL parser
capabilities.description: Parse and normalize URLs. Do NOT fetch them.

capabilities.title: Image generator
capabilities.description: Generate raster images. Do NOT use for HTTP.

capabilities.title: Pinned audit trail
capabilities.description: Always-on audit logger. May score below threshold; pin must survive budget.

capabilities.title: High-score helper B
capabilities.description: Near sibling of helper A; usually a budget near-miss.

capabilities.title: High-score helper C
capabilities.description: Third high scorer; must be disclosed when the ceiling cuts it.
